name: FLUX.2 [klein] 4B
description: Black Forest Labs' compact open-weight FLUX.2 text-to-image model, sub-second on a good GPU; Apache-2.0.

restrictions: The 9B klein models use the FLUX Non-Commercial License; only the 4B is Apache-2.0
license.notes: Release date from Vercel AI Gateway page only (single source). BFL repo black-forest-labs/flux2 Apache-2.0 code.

bundleSize.source: README: ~8 GB VRAM; 4B weights several GB

cost.notes: Local weights; hosted at USD 0.014 first megapixel via BFL (2026-11-14).

verdictReason: Best-licensed open model of the set, but ~8 GB VRAM and multi-GB weights rule out in-browser use; use hosted or user-installed.
